title: "It's A Wonderful Life"
seo_title: It's A Wonderful Life at Stained Glass Theatre, Joplin
description: It's A Wonderful Life is a stage adaptation by James W. Rodgers of the Frank Capra film, following George Bailey of Bedford Falls as his guardian angel shows him what life would have been like had he never existed. Stained Glass Theatre stages it to start the holiday season, with tickets sold online through SimpleTix and group rates available by phone. It takes place November 19, 2026 (Time TBD) at 2101 Annie Baxter Ave in Joplin, MO.
